description: Passage-level questions for the chunking comparison (evaluation/compare_chunking.py). A retrieved chunk answers a question when its text, title prefix excluded, contains at least one term of every group in 'answer' (whole words, case- and accent-insensitive). Every answer was checked to occur in the long-text corpus, in few places (data/processed/tunisia_wikipedia_*.json and fulltext_*.json).
